div.head: Wl lad Prol.
div.ab: Wilhelm cyng gret ealla þa þe ðys gewrit to cymð ofer eall Englaland freondlice, 7 beot 7 eac cyð eallum mannum ofer eall Angelcynn to healdenne, þæt is:
King William sends friendly greetings to all those throughout England to whom this document comes, and enjoins and instructs all men throughout all England to observe what follows:
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 232–233 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added; ealla: so the manuscript (Robertson's note).
